items.headline: LIV Golf Future Uncertain
items.text: LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil would not guarantee the league's last four 2026 events will be played amid reports that PIF might pull funding and a possible schedule reduction to 10 events.

items.headline: Gary Player's Swing Tip
items.text: Gary Player advises amateurs not to let their head move forward during the swing to successfully draw the ball, emphasizing keeping the head back for better club release.
